name: io.github.hostkey-cloud-ru/mcp-server-ru
description: MCP-сервер Hostkey .ru (InvAPI): серверы, питание, заказ, DNS, S3, биллинг

environmentVariables.name: HOSTKEY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: InvAPI API key for the .ru portal (invapi.hostkey.ru); per-server keys supported

environmentVariables.name: HOSTKEY_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow destructive operations (OS reinstall, PXE cycle, service cancellation)
